ai_master_body:
This switch turns on every AI action — Refine, Organize, and Gather. By default your content goes to Google's Gemini API for processing; switch to a local Ollama instance in Settings and nothing leaves this PC.

If you're using the Google API, it's worth reading through their data handling policy once.
ai_master_learn_more: AI helps in three ways — Refine (tidies up your writing; the result lands in a new section, your original is untouched), Organize (suggests titles and tags, saved only after you confirm), and Gather (brings in outside content, like a link summary, while keeping the original). Turning AI on doesn't turn every feature on — each one is switched separately under Settings > AI Features.
sync_server_body: Another device on the same network (your Tailscale tailnet, or this PC itself) reads and writes your notes using the issued token — including running AI actions. Reissue the token any time from this screen; the old one stops working immediately.
capture_channel_body: Clipping, visit history, and SMS parsing all share one token. Any automation app (Tasker, Shortcuts) or browser extension that knows this token writes notes into this PC, so treat it like a password. Copy it from Settings > Connect.
